en: I'll keep an eye out for it.
note: keep an eye out for + 东西：一边走一边留意找

en: It's no more than a three-minute walk.
note: no more than：最多、不超过；a three-minute walk：步行三分钟的路程

zh: 走过去应该五分钟左右。
en: You should be able to walk there in five minutes, give or take.
note: give or take：放在数字后面，表示「左右」

zh: 我都清楚了，不用再说了。
note: I'm all set：我都好了，不需要别的了；也可以回答店员「还要什么吗」

en: Thanks, but I've really got to get going.
note: I've got to = I have to；get going：动身、出发

zh: 抱歉，我这周六要出去旅行，所以没时间去爬山。
en: Sorry, I'm going on a trip this Saturday, so I don't have time to go hiking.
note: go on a trip：去旅行；don't have time to + 动词原形；爬山说 go hiking

zh: 我约了医生。其实我有点头疼。
en: I have a doctor's appointment. Actually, I have a bit of a headache.
note: a doctor's appointment：约了看医生（别漏 a）；头疼说 have a headache，不说 my brain is pain

zh: 要不我们下周六去爬山？我很想跟你一起去。
en: Maybe we can go hiking next Saturday? I'd love to go with you.
note: can 后面用原形：can go；I'd love to…：我很想……，婉拒后提出别的时间

zh: 结婚以后，把我们俩公寓的东西搬过来，应该就够了。
en: After we're married, we'll just take the things from each of our two apartments and that should do the trick.
note: do the trick：管用、能解决问题；That should do the trick. 这样应该就行了

en: That just leaves the living room.
note: leave 这里是“剩下”：That leaves…… 那就剩……了，可换词：That just leaves one question.

zh: 我本来只是想赶回家看下午的比赛。
en: I was just hoping to get home in time for the game this afternoon.
note: I was just hoping…：我本来只是想……（委婉抱怨）；in time for：及时赶上某事（≠ on time 准时）

zh: 几个月前他在公司没被提拔。
en: He was passed over for a promotion at work a couple of months ago.
note: be passed over for a promotion：升职时被跳过，别人升了他没升（不是他自己放弃）；a couple of months：几个月

zh: （听完对方讲的原因）难怪会这样。
note: That would do it：那就说得通了、难怪；对别人讲的原因表示理解，不是“那会做它”
be fed up with…：受够了、烦透了；可换词：I'm fed up with my job.

zh: 别绕弯子了，直接告诉我。
en: Don't beat around the bush. Just tell me.
note: beat around the bush：说话绕圈子、不说重点；催对方说重点时整句可用

zh: 我原来也这么想，可谁说得准呢。
en: I thought so, too, but you never know.
note: you never know：世事难料、说不准；表达不确定，不是“你永远不知道”
